item.title: What we know about the deadly flooding on the Nepal-Tibet border
item.description: Nearly 100 people are dead, and many more are missing, after an avalanche of ice and rock blocked a Himalayan river valley, triggering massive flash floods in Nepal.
item.content:encoded: Nearly 100 people are dead, and many more are missing, after an avalanche of ice and rock blocked a Himalayan river valley, triggering massive flash floods in Nepal.

item.title: Drugstores say Medicare's $50 obesity drug program is catching on
item.description: The Bridge program, which began July 1, makes some Medicare beneficiaries eligible for obesity drugs for $50 a month. CVS and Walgreens say they've each already filled 100,000 such prescriptions.

item.title: Why many Black Americans feel a special kinship with Dolly Parton

item.description: The WNBA's popularity has risen in recent years, but so have threats and abuse directed at its players. One team is taking a novel approach to this, by partnering with national security specialists.

item.title: In Louisiana, NDAs covered up a data center deal that residents didn't know was coming
item.description: Residents of tiny Boyce, La., yelled at local officials for signing agreements that hid a pending deal for a data center. NDAs, common in Louisiana data center deals, are coming under more scrutiny.

item.title: Hollywood's summer box office is glowing, but the numbers come with startling caveats
item.description: Theaters have had something for everyone this summer, and fans are paying top dollar for formats like IMAX. There are also fewer moviegoers, fewer movies, and fewer screens than there were pre-COVID.
